Name: Farmer's Satchel
Author: BurninWeeknd
Description:
[b]Farmer’s Satchel

[/b]Adds an upgradable tool that holds seeds and fertilizer.

Load it like bait on a fishing rod and charge it like a watering can to plant rows or areas instantly.

—

[b]Planting Sizes by Tier
[/b]Base: 1x1 (No charge)  
Copper: 1x3  
Steel: 1x5  
Gold: 3x3  
Iridium: 3x6 (Reaching enchant 5x5)  
Radioactive: 5x5 (Reaching enchant 7x7)[center][b]
All Upgrade Tiers[/b][/center]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/43623/43623-1774565076-1005759092.jpg[/img]

—

[i]Note: Fully charged behaves like the hoe/watering can. Clicking plants 1x1.

[/i]—
